name: Gabbai
title: Benjamite in Jerusalem after the exile
summary: Gabbai was a Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile. He is mentioned in Nehemiah's list of those living in Jerusalem as part of the rebuilding of the Jewish community. Although little is known about him personally, he represents the faithful who returned to restore the nation.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the inhabitants of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Gabbai is mentioned as one of the Benjamites who settled in Jerusalem after returning from Babylon, as part of Nehemiah's census.

keyEvents.title: Repopulation of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: After the walls were rebuilt, Nehemiah organized a repopulation of Jerusalem in which one out of every ten Israelites was chosen to live in the holy city. Gabbai was among those who took part in this.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Benjamin in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Gabbai was part of a group of Benjamites under the leadership of Joel, son of Zikri, which formed an important part of Jerusalem's population after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's organization of the people
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah kept careful lists of the families who returned and settled in Jerusalem and the surrounding cities, showing the importance of preserving genealogical records.
